compositions.name: Containment into Black Hole
compositions.reason: Zarus identifies the reachable target before Coliseum; Gideon follows only after key interrupts are covered. Push the nearby wave before moving together to the objective entrance. Protect Gideon through the first 2.75s; then he can reposition while Black Hole finishes. A short catch does not guarantee the full channel. The arena is not a stun. Escapes and a broken channel shield can defeat the follow-up.

compositions.name: Direct catch, compact burst
compositions.reason: Steel confirms Shield Bash or Shield Slam; Belica follows with Seismic Assault and Void Bomb without wasting both controls at once. Convert the pick into nearby vision or an objective. Two control tools do not replace damage economy. Steel Jungle has the smaller current sample.

compositions.name: Second-wave dive
compositions.reason: Mourn creates the first catch while Serath waits for enemy peel, then enters the reachable target. Keep a response beside the allied carry instead of both chasing the reset. No takedown means no visage extension. An early unsupported Serath entry defeats the plan.

compositions.name: Buy time for Sparrow
compositions.reason: Muriel times amplification and protection to a safe firing window; Sparrow attacks the nearest useful target. Other roles must provide the opening and a durable body. This duo lacks dependable long-range initiation; it cannot solve a flank by damage alone.

compositions.name: Protect the channel
compositions.reason: Set the target with Zarus, reserve protection for Gideon’s entry and channel, and keep Reversal for a valid distant commitment. Leave a route back toward the carry. Protect Gideon through the first 2.75s; then he can reposition while Black Hole finishes. A short catch does not guarantee the full channel. Spending all protection on the first entry exposes the next fight. Do not assume a shield survives burst or anti-shield.

compositions.name: Catch, silence, convert
compositions.reason: Layer a confirmed stun into Belica’s burst; Drongo uses silence to obstruct the response and keeps attacking within Rad Rounds. Plan the airborne blast direction before using it. No sustain support is included yet. Reserve another role for protection and avoid displacing the focus out of allied damage.

compositions.name: Grouped sustain and cleanup
compositions.reason: Aurora controls the approach, Narbash follows with Thunk and grouped sustain, and Legion places physical area pressure on the held route. Move together before starting the objective. The control is partly delayed. Anti-heal, dispersed targets or a second flank can break the grouped fight.

compositions.name: Peel before damage
compositions.reason: Steel takes the first contact while retaining a control tool for the diver. Muriel keeps Sparrow firing; only commit the objective when the remaining roles can provide magical damage and wave control. The trio alone has no dedicated magical damage plan and can overcommit its only initiating tank.

compositions.name: Controlled front-to-back
compositions.reason: Greystone pressures space while Steel or Mourn confirms the catch. Gideon follows; Sparrow attacks from behind the second body. Keep one support control for the counter-dive and use the won space for objectives. Protect Gideon through the first 2.75s; then he can reposition while Black Hole finishes. A short catch does not guarantee the full channel. Do not overlap every control or throw all three frontliners into the channel area. Greystone’s personal extra life is not peel for Sparrow.

compositions.name: Compact catch with protection
compositions.reason: Use Zarus or Belica to identify a single target, Drongo to constrain the response, and Muriel to protect the actual damage window. Akeron occupies the close entrance while the team keeps a ranged exit. Akeron and Zarus can overcommit together. Disengage from failed catches rather than chase past Muriel and the carries.

compositions.name: Prepared objective control
compositions.reason: Arrive first, establish vision and layer Aurora/Fey control over Legion’s physical area damage. Narbash supports the grouped advance while Greystone occupies the second angle. Several effects require time and enemies remaining nearby. Do not force into spread ranged poke or ignore a flank while standing together.

compositions.name: Protected second entry
compositions.reason: Akeron and Steel establish contact; Belica confirms a target. Serath waits for peel to be spent while Eden maintains a reachable firing pattern. Save one Steel control for the counter-dive. Two mechanical damage picks make execution demanding. Do not send both into the first control rotation or assume a reset will repair a failed opening.
